segments.name: Commercial Lines Insurance
segments.description: Provides commercial liability, property, auto, workers' compensation and specialized coverage to businesses.
segments.evidence: The five commercial business lines are: • Commercial casualty – Provides coverage to businesses against third-party liability from accidents occurring on their premises or arising out of their operations, including injuries sustained from products or liability related to professional services.

segments.name: Personal Lines Insurance
segments.description: Provides personal auto, homeowner and other personal insurance products to individuals through independent agencies.
segments.evidence: The personal lines insurance segment contributed net earned premiums of $3.199 billion to 2025 consolidated total revenues, or 25.3% of the total, and reported a loss before income taxes of $111 million.

segments.name: Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance
segments.description: Provides non-standard commercial liability and property coverage for unique business risks with higher rates and customized terms.
segments.evidence: The excess and surplus lines segment contributed net earned premiums of $698 million to 2025 consolidated total revenues, or 5.5% of the total, and reported profit before income taxes of $85 million.

segments.name: Life Insurance
segments.description: Provides life insurance policies and fixed annuities through The Cincinnati Life Insurance Company.
segments.evidence: The Cincinnati Life Insurance Company (Cincinnati Life), which provides life insurance policies and fixed annuities

segments.name: Investments
segments.description: Manages the parent company investment portfolio and provides commercial leasing and financing services.
segments.evidence: CFC Investment Company, which offers commercial leasing and financing services to our agencies, their clients and other customers.

revenueModel.text: Independent insurance agencies and policyholders pay premiums for property casualty insurance, life insurance and fixed annuities; investment income earned on invested assets.
revenueModel.evidence: Our main business is property casualty insurance marketed through independent insurance agencies in 46 states.
